Operator: Good morning, and welcome to the Vistra Corp second quarter twenty twenty-five earnings conference call. All participants will be in a listen-only mode. After today's presentation, there will be an opportunity to ask questions.
Jim Burke: Thanks, operator, and good morning everyone. We appreciate you joining us today. This was another strong quarter for Vistra, and data center demand for our contracted generation fleet continues to accelerate across our footprint.
Kristopher Moldovan: Thank you, Jim. Turning to the financial results, adjusted EBITDA for the quarter came in ahead of our internal expectations, driven by higher realized power prices and disciplined cost management across the retail and generation segments.
Operator: Thank you. We will now begin the question and answer session. Our first question comes from the line of an analyst covering the independent power producer sector.
Jim Burke: Great question. On the data center pipeline specifically, we have now signed incremental capacity agreements that extend contracted volumes well into the next decade, and we are seeing accelerating interconnection requests from hyperscale customers.
Kristopher Moldovan: To add some color on the capital allocation side, we remain committed to our balanced approach of debt reduction, the dividend, and opportunistic share repurchases, and today's results reinforce that plan is on track.
